reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "docs: remove OLM installation and release docs by @Skarlso in https://github.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/pull/4617", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Documentation-only change: removing the OLM installation and release docs has no operational effect on running installations; the evidence states nothing that stops working, and it does not state that OLM-based installation itself was removed.
consequence.remediation: Operators who install external-secrets via OLM should note the installation docs are no longer provided in the repository.

proposed.statement: The 0.16.0 release notes state that the OLM installation and release documentation was removed by PR #4617; this is a documentation-only removal with no stated change to any product surface.
